julie_csm: Heads-up — weekly Lumenware health check. p95/p99 split by route/model and streaming vs sync. Noticed p99 spike on rerank and spend drift. Sharing quick snapshot. cc @sam_eng @raf_k
raf_k: Sharing numbers from the telemetry window (2026-03-13 00:00–23:59 UTC):
```
route/model       | mode      | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | err_rate(%) | tokens/day | spend/day($)
chat-v1           | streaming | 120     | 260     | 0.12        | 1.2M       | 420
chat-v1           | sync      | 140     | 450     | 0.50        | 0.9M       | 390
embed-128         | sync      | 90      | 160     | 0.02        | 3.5M       | 210
rerank-2          | streaming | 220     | 780     | 1.80        | 0.12M      | 95
rerank-2          | sync      | 300     | 950     | 2.10        | 0.08M      | 88
```
sam_eng: rerank p99 780ms is high — is that streaming path causing serialization? any queue depth spikes?
raf_k: Queue depth did hit 18 at 03:08 UTC on dedicated-pool-us-west, saw latency climb with concurrent small requests. No GPU OOMs. Error rate bump for rerank coincides with token surge on embed calls.
mia_cs: Customer reported slower UI during report generation yesterday. They're on Dedicated. Renewal next month — want mitigation plan.
raf_k: Immediate mitigations: increase burst_capacity from 2->4 for rerank route, enable prefix/KV caching for chat-v1 sync, and apply small request batching window 10ms for rerank. I'll run the changes tonight during low traffic.
sam_eng: Sounds good. Also suggest enabling streaming fallback to sync for rerank on heavy tails? we can route large requests to cheaper variant.
raf_k: Routing policy already set to prefer streaming for chat-v1, but rerank uses sync by default. We can flip to streaming for <=32 tokens, and sync for large items. I'll open an A/B canary.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled config update for 'lumenware-rerank' at 02:00 UTC · canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% · rollback 15m
julie_csm: I'll book a 30-min remediation sync with Lumenware CS + Eng — Tue 10am PT. Also flag renewal risk on CRM if we see another regression.
mia_cs: :thumbsup: Please include cost impact estimate. Their avg daily spend jumped 18% this week.
raf_k: Estimate: caching + batching should reduce tokens/sec by ~12% and cost by ~9% — rough. If rerank p99 drops to ~300ms we avoid UI timeouts.
julie_csm: Action items: raf_k implement config changes and monitor p95/p99; sam_eng validate fallback routing; mia_cs prep customer note and runbook for UI timeout; julie_csm schedule call and update CRM. I'll follow up Fri.
sam_eng: On it. Will add dashboard tile for p99 by route+mode and error rate annotations. Query we'll use: `SELECT p95(p99) FROM latency WHERE route GROUP BY mode, model` (pseudo)
mia_cs: Thanks team. Customer prefers email summary before call.
raf_k: I'll post a short postmortem if we need rollback. For now, rolling out canary tonight.
